off_by_one_bound: A loop, slice or index boundary is shifted by one, so the first or last element is skipped or read twice.
missing_empty_case: The empty-input case is not handled before the main logic runs.
wrong_init: A starting value is wrong (for example 0 instead of negative infinity, or the wrong seed element).
wrong_comparison: A comparison is too strict or too loose, or tests the wrong relationship (< vs <=, == vs !=).
accumulator_reset: A running value is reset on every iteration, or updated by assignment instead of accumulation.
wrong_operator: An arithmetic or logical operator (or operand order) is wrong.
missing_edge_single: Very small inputs (one or two elements) take a wrong early path or fall through without returning.
hardcoded_output: The answer is copied from the examples instead of being computed from the input.
